content:
The iteration failed due to a missing formatted string in the HWPX section XML, causing a regression in the verifier reward from 1.00 to 0.00.
The test_required_values_present_and_repeated_value_updated failed with an AssertionError in /tests/test_outputs.py. Specifically, the assertion '1990-11-02 (35세)' in section_xml failed, indicating the expected birthdate and age format was not correctly injected into section0.xml. While basic patient name matching worked, the combined string format was missing from the generated HWPML output.
